description: This file defines an enumeration for different interest recalculation period methods used in the loan product domain within the Apache Fineract project. It includes constants for various period types and utility methods for mapping integer values to enum instances.

classes.name: InterestRecalculationPeriodMethod
classes.description: Enumeration representing different interest recalculation periods such as DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, etc., with associated integer values and string codes.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method that retrieves the enum instance corresponding to a given integer value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum instance.
